definitions.gloss: to scrape together, to rake up
definitions.explanation: To physically gather scattered things by scraping or raking them into one place.

definitions.gloss: to scrape together, to round up
definitions.explanation: To gather with effort from various sources, often implying difficulty or urgency.

examples.japanese: ⟦{砂|すな}→砂：00890_suna⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掻|か}き{集|あつ}めた。
⟦{落|お}ち{葉|ば}→落ち葉：14108_ochiba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掻|か}き{集|あつ}めて⟦{袋|ふくろ}→袋：00837_fukuro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れた→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。

notes:
USAGE: {掻|か}き{集|あつ}める is a compound verb combining ⟦{掻|か}く→掻く：09647_kaku⟧ (to scrape, to scratch) and ⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧ (to gather). The {掻|か}き～ prefix adds a nuance of hasty or vigorous action.

TRANSITIVITY: Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧). Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for what is being gathered.

ASPECT: {掻|か}き{集|あつ}めている indicates ongoing gathering activity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掻|か}き{集|あつ}める (to scrape together funds)
- ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掻|か}き{集|あつ}める (to gather information)
- ⟦{人手|ひとで}→人手：25438_hitode⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掻|か}き{集|あつ}める (to round up workers)
- ⟦{落|お}ち{葉|ば}→落ち葉：14108_ochiba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{掻|か}き{集|あつ}める (to rake up fallen leaves)

NUANCE: Implies effort, urgency, or gathering from disparate sources. More emphatic than simple ⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧.
